b4953325ad.q: How much MPG improvement can aerodynamic devices deliver on a trucking fleet over millions of miles?
b4953325ad.a: Aerodynamic devices like solar panels, wheel covers, side fairing extenders, and trailer top edge kits can save a tenth to two tenths of a mile per gallon per truck. When annualized across 40 to 60 million miles, these small fractions accumulate into significant fuel cost savings that pay dividends in the long run, especially at current high diesel prices.

086d596fd4.q: What aerodynamic aftermarket products does GP Transco install on tractors and trailers?
086d596fd4.a: GP Transco installs Flow Below wheel covers and side fairing extenders on tractors as OE options, and TransTex top edge kits and bottom skirts on trailers to reduce drag at the rear. Most of these devices are now installed at the dealer during pre-delivery inspection rather than aftermarket, making installation seamless before trucks hit the road.

c53e3db946.q: How does GP Transco use driver incentive programs to reduce idle time and improve fuel economy?
c53e3db946.a: GP Transco implemented an elite score system that grades drivers on multiple metrics including MPG and idle percentage. Drivers who reduce idle below a certain threshold become eligible for monthly bonuses applied per mile driven. This gamified leaderboard approach allows drivers to compete with each other while earning extra cents per mile, significantly boosting driver incentive.

f0751064e0.q: What results has GP Transco achieved with solar panel pilots to reduce overnight engine restarts?
f0751064e0.a: GP Transco piloted solar panels on truck roof fairings starting in mid-2024. The panels allow batteries to hold charge longer during driver breaks, eliminating unnecessary engine restarts. In pilot testing, one driver reduced overnight restarts from four down to one, demonstrating meaningful fuel savings without engine idling for HVAC, appliances, and comfort systems.

c281e0559d.q: What two-day driver training curriculum does GP Transco use to educate drivers on fuel efficiency?
c281e0559d.a: GP Transco conducts a two-day new driver orientation with Monday-Tuesday and Wednesday-Thursday classes, regularly enrolling 5 to 15 drivers per class. Training covers idling reduction, driver behavior, smooth accelerations, and anticipation of braking. Drivers scoring poorly receive retraining and a monitored improvement plan to meet company fuel efficiency standards or face parting ways.
